== Summary ==
Slip “•Kashyyyk: Chewie’s Hut” cut unchanged from page 4 of the Players Committee's [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-26-Errata-Combined.pdf Virtual Set 26 release sheet with errata] (PDF file created 26 December 2025), rendered at 200 dpi (pixel box (68, 54, 755, 602)). Version [[Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut|Kashyyyk: Chewie's Hut (Errata)]] (PC-E1). Not a recreation.
